# REL-02: safety / auth / actuation paths. A PR touching any of these needs TWO approvals from
# people other than the author, on the PR's latest commit (enforced by the `safety-review-gate`
# check, .github/workflows/review-gate.yml). Task board release policy: no single person may
# self-merge safety-critical changes.
#
# One entry per line: an exact repo-relative file, or a directory prefix ending in `/`.
# Every entry must also appear in .github/CODEOWNERS (tests/test_ci_policy.py checks this).
# This file is itself safety-critical: weakening the list needs the same two reviews.
